traits_empty: Place units on the board: shared classes and origins unlock bonuses.
help_text: Buy units in the shop, then drag them from the bench to your half of the board, at the bottom. They fight the enemy team on their own; the enemies are shown at the top during preparation. Three identical units merge into a stronger one. Shared classes and origins unlock synergies. Survive the 15 rounds. Hover a unit to see its stats.
